description: Allow Workflow tasks and checks to execute a project Agent through a durable server-resolved runtime Action snapshot.

tasks.title: Add the virtual Agent Action contract for tasks and checks
tasks.description: Add the server-owned `mohist/agent` manifest with closed `name`, `prompt`, optional `session`, and optional `timeout` inputs to profile catalog validation. Apply the same contract to task and check definitions without querying current Agent state during profile save.
acceptanceCriteria: Profiles accept valid mohist/agent tasks and checks before the referenced Agent exists
Missing name or prompt and unknown inputs fail profile validation for tasks and checks
Template prompt values remain valid at profile-save time
tasks.output: Server virtual Action manifest and profile validation specs
tasks.notes: The Runner must not register mohist/agent.

tasks.title: Resolve Agent references and persist task/check dispatch snapshots
tasks.description: Extract an active-only name-or-id Agent execution snapshot resolver. Extend Workflow active-work state and grain commands to compare-and-store a complete transformed WorkDispatch. Transform task uses and each checks[*] uses before storage; poll redelivery reads the stored envelope and retry/new checks work resolves again.
acceptanceCriteria: Task and check dispatches resolve an active Agent to concrete mohist/opencode or mohist/pi envelopes with raw prompt retained
After Agent edit plus server restart or grain activation, redelivery returns the original stored envelope
A task retry and a newly-created checks attempt resolve the current Agent definition
No Agent entity, AgentJob, or direct AgentSession lifecycle enters Workflow
tasks.output: Agent execution snapshot resolver, durable Workflow active-work dispatch snapshot, translator and poll reconciliation specs
tasks.notes: Store the full wire envelope, not only Agent identity or config.

tasks.title: Carry Agent instructions through both runtime Actions
tasks.description: Extend mohist/opencode and mohist/pi to accept only options.instructions, options.model, and options.variant. Validate the closed shape, compose instructions before rendered prompt, forward model/variant and input/default timeout to their runtime turn requests, and leave inline Action behavior unchanged when instructions are absent.
acceptanceCriteria: OpenCode and Pi receive instructions before the rendered workflow prompt, with the prompt retained as the current goal
Both Actions reject unknown or malformed options and forward model, variant, and supplied timeout
Absent timeout retains the existing one-hour Action default and runtime timeout failures retain their current error codes
Fake-runtime tests cover both backends without Agent lookup
tasks.output: Runner Action/runtime option contracts and focused tests for OpenCode and Pi
tasks.notes: The server sends `{ prompt, session?, timeout?, options }`; no arbitrary AgentConfig reaches Runner.

tasks.title: Preserve structured Agent resolution failures in Workflow reports
tasks.description: Make dispatch rejection carry ExecutionError through DispatchService and IWorkflowGrain. Failed task dispatch stores agent_not_found on TaskRun. Failed checks dispatch records agent_not_found on the unresolved named check and check-not-run on remaining checks, then uses normal Workflow recovery and advancement decisions.
acceptanceCriteria: Missing or archived task Agent produces TaskRun.Error.code equal to agent_not_found and recovery can match failure.error.code
Missing or archived check Agent produces a named agent_not_found CheckResult and check-not-run results for remaining batch entries
Neither failure path offers Runner work or creates an AgentSession or AgentJob
tasks.output: Structured Workflow dispatch rejection path with task/check specs
tasks.notes: Workflow remains the decision maker; this task only preserves Runner-independent facts.

tasks.title: Verify the complete Workflow-owned Agent Action behavior
tasks.description: Add focused server and runner coverage for task/check transformation, snapshot redelivery and retry, runtime input composition, structured resolution failures, Workflow-origin session addressing, and unchanged inline Action behavior. Run affected server and runner typecheck/test suites.
acceptanceCriteria: Specs cover both OpenCode and Pi task paths and an Agent-backed check path
Specs prove no AgentJob is created and named Workflow sessions retain their existing namespace
npm test and npm run typecheck -w packages/runner pass without real runtime, network, filesystem, or wall-clock dependencies
tasks.output: Focused server/runner regression coverage and passing verification commands
tasks.notes: Use existing fake runtime hosts and injected time only.
